content.title: Hikayemiz
content.content: Thaproban Beach House, adını antik Taproban kralından almaktadır ve adanın zengin mirasını yansıtmaktadır. Otelimiz, kişiselleştirilmiş hizmet ile tropikal lüks otantik bir deneyimi sunmak için oluşturuldu.

content.title: Наша История
content.content: Thaproban Beach House назван в честь древнего короля Тапробана, отражая богатое наследие острова. Наш отель был создан для того, чтобы предложить гостям аутентичный experience of tropical luxury.

content.title: Thaproban Beach House - Kısa Açıklama
content.content: Thaproban Beach House, Sri Lanka'nın Unawatuna bölgesinde lüks bir plaj oteli olup, altın kuma ve Hint Okyanusu'na doğrudan erişim sunmaktadır.

content.title: Thaproban Beach House - Краткое Описание
content.content: Thaproban Beach House - это роскошный пляжный отель в Унаватуне, Шри-Ланка, offering прямой доступ к золотому песку и Индийскому океану. Наш отель сочетает современный комфорт с традиционной shri-lankan гостеприимством.

content.title: Detaylı Açıklama
content.content: Thaproban Beach House, Sri Lanka'nın en güzel plajlarından biri olan Unawatuna'nın kalbinde yer almaktadır. Odalarımız Deluxe İki Kişilik Oda, Manzaralı Superior İki Kişilik Oda ve özel Penthouse Süit'i içerir.

content.title: Подробное Описание
content.content: Thaproban Beach House расположен в центре Унаватуны, одного из самых красивых пляжей Шри-Ланки. Наши номера включают Deluxe Double Room, Superior Double Room с видом на море, и эксклюзивный Penthouse Suite.

rooms.name: Deluxe Double Room
rooms.description: Your private balcony offers a personal outdoor space to savor morning coffee or evening tranquility in Unawatuna's tropical warmth. Inside, air conditioning maintains a refreshing retreat where you can unwind in the comfortable seating area—ideal for planning coastal explorations or quiet relaxation. This Deluxe Double Room balances comfort and personal space for your Sri Lankan journey.

rooms.name: Penthouse Suite
rooms.description: Reach new heights in our Penthouse Suite, where elevated privacy meets Unawatuna's tropical warmth. Unwind in well-appointed spaces designed for serenity, with the entire floor as your exclusive domain. This is top-floor living at its most inviting.

rooms.name: Superior Double Room
rooms.description: Your private balcony offers a personal vantage point to absorb Unawatuna's tropical rhythms, perfect for morning coffees as humidity lifts. Inside, powerful air conditioning delivers crisp relief while rich hardwood floors lend natural elegance underfoot. This Superior Double Room balances refreshing comfort with tactile warmth for your Sri Lankan explorations.

rooms.name: Superior Double Room with Sea View
rooms.description: Your superior double room centers on the sea view, a living canvas of shifting blues and horizons. Wake to morning light dancing across the water's surface, casting shimmering reflections that fill your space with natural warmth. As dusk settles, watch the sky melt into sunset hues from your comfortable vantage point—a serene backdrop for shared moments. This thoughtfully appointed retreat frames the coastal panorama for two.
